caption: The drawing depicts a single outfit consisting of a short-sleeved top and high-waisted trousers, rendered in shades of light brown and beige. The top has puffed sleeves ending with a fitted band and features a rounded neckline. There are decorative elements along the chest and down the front, comprising rows of small circular buttons or beads, and two parallel rows of leafy vine-like embroidery running vertically from the neckline to the hem of the top. The waist is defined by a peplum ruffle that extends around the midsection. The lower garment is a pair of high-waisted, wide-legged trousers with several details: a diagonal side pocket with a flap on the right side, a large button near the waistband, another circular button along the left seam, and a visible patch sewn onto the left knee area. The hems of the trousers appear to be double-folded. The objects are rendered with shading to suggest volume and fabric texture, and the entire composition is presented against a plain, off-white background.
title: Boy's Suit
